title: UK Autumn Budget 2026 — Chancellor's statement plus the OBR Economic and Fiscal Outlook, on the same day as the FOMC
source: NEWS: THE PREFIX UNDERSTATES THE EVIDENCE AND IS A TAXONOMY ARTIFACT, NOT A DOUBT ABOUT THE DATE. Primary, fetched direct 2026-09-09 (HTTP 200): gov.uk/government/publications/chancellor-letter-to-the-treasury-select-committee-tsc-budget-2026-date, an HM Treasury publication dated 31 July 2026, states 'The Budget will be held on 28 October 2026'. Corroborated the same session from a second HM Treasury primary on the same date, gov.uk/government/news/budget-to-move-power-and-money-out-of-westminster-and-into-every-postcode-around-britain ('Wednesday 28 October', Chancellor John Healey MP, 'It will be built on fiscal discipline'). Mechanically cross-checked by weekday arithmetic: all TEN Budgets whose gov.uk topical-event timestamp this session could corroborate (2014-03-19, 2015-07-08, 2016-03-16, 2017-11-22, 2020-03-11, 2021-03-03, 2021-10-27, 2024-03-06, 2024-10-30, 2025-11-26) fall on a WEDNESDAY, the post-PMQs convention, and 2026-10-28 is a Wednesday. The accompanying OBR Economic and Fiscal Outlook is press-reported rather than fetched — obr.uk returned HTTP 403 to this lane's egress — with the statutory floor read direct from legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/2011/4/section/4 (HTTP 200): the Budget Responsibility and National Audit Act 2011 s.4(3) requires OBR forecasts 'on at least two occasions for each financial year', which makes an autumn EFO the norm without mandating this specific date. Filed estimate on the same taxonomy count as every other non-US entry on this calendar: market-events-data.ts's confirmed-prefix list (IR:/CAL:/BLS:/FED:/PJM:/SEC:/TSY:/OCC:/BEA:/CENSUS:/ISM:/CB:/UMICH:/FHFA:) has no slot for HM Treasury or any other foreign finance ministry, and NEWS: is the only estimate prefix that is not a pure reasoning estimate. Proposed 2026-09-09 by the boe-decision-2026-09-17 lane; researched and made canonical by its own lane the same day
notes: RESEARCHED 2026-09-09 by its own lane (docs/research/events/uk-autumn-budget-2026-10-28.md), which re-fetched every primary rather than inheriting the proposer's. The proposal it supersedes is proposals/uk-autumn-budget-2026-10-28.from-boe-decision-2026-09-17.json, now inert. TITLE AMENDED to name the collision that is this entry's whole operational content: 2026-10-28 IS ALSO FOMC DAY (fomc-2026-10-28, impact high), with the Budget speech at 12:30 London = 08:30 ET (the UK is on GMT from 2026-10-25, the US still on EDT until 2026-11-01) and the FOMC statement 5.5 hours later at 14:00 ET. Twenty-nine other tracked events sit within 5 days, including gdp-q3-2026-advance and pce on 10-29, ecb-decision 10-29, boj-decision and eci-q3 on 10-30, ism-manufacturing and treasury-borrowing-estimates on 11-02. IMPACT LOW, AND MEASURED RATHER THAN ASSUMED. Across the 9 gov.uk-corroborated Budget days since 2014 (2020-03-11 excluded as the WHO pandemic-declaration day, S&P -4.89%), against a control of every non-Budget Wednesday since 2014: S&P 500 mean |close-to-close| 0.70% vs 0.70% (1.00x), US 10y 4.09bp vs 3.90bp (1.05x, Welch t = -0.16 on the matched test), and the following week 1.01x and 1.07x. The naive n=10 result (S&P 1.56x) is ENTIRELY the one confound. The gilt-to-Treasury pipe is real and strong — daily d(^TNX) on IGLT.L return, 2008-2026: b = -6.08bp per +1% gilt price, t = -45.3, R-squared 0.308, n = 4610; on the worst 1% of gilt days (<= -1.30%) the US 10y rose a mean +6.7bp, 37/46 positive, against an all-day mean of -0.01bp — but a Budget has never delivered a move big enough to open it: the worst Budget-day gilt sell-off in the sample is -1.13%, and the only move past +/-1.30% was 2021-10-27's +2.04% RALLY. Gilts do respond, as a resolution event rather than a shock: 1.35x an ordinary Wednesday into and on the day, 0.91x in the week after. The one modern UK fiscal event that did reach US markets is the 2022-09-23 mini-budget (IGLT.L -7.54% close-to-close and -9.53% peak-to-trough to 2026-10-14, US 10y +30bp, S&P -4.65%), and it carried two structural markers this one does not: it was a FRIDAY, not the Wednesday every corroborated Budget shares, and it published NO OBR forecast. Even there the US transmission arrived D+1/D+2 (09-26 +18bp, 09-27 +9bp), not on the day (09-23, -1bp).
